name: Twisted Magic stacks a Shadow-damage-taken debuff on critical direct harmful casts (#1014)
contract: Twisted Magic 704634 applies aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Twisted Magic 504138, but Spell.dbc gives it ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so it never procced. With a spell_proc row gated on direct harmful damage done and critical hits, casting a crit-guaranteed damage spell should stack 504138 on the target. Casts Bloodbolt rank 578305 (module progression grants the level-52 rank 578304 up to level 52, and 578305 from level 60 on; a level-80 character owns only 578305 - casting 578304 gets no server response and zero damage). spell_crit_rating 100000 guarantees the crit deterministically instead of hoping for one.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
No Twisted Magic debuff before any cast
Twisted Magic applies after a critical direct hit
Twisted Magic stacks on a second critical hit
